title: Browser tabs — catalogue card
brief: preview.png for the herdr Browser tabs mod in the herdr.dev/mods gallery. Replaces the raw 927x945 panel capture (letterboxed inside the 960x600 card frame) with a composed 1600x1000 card: headline, three proof points, and a mock of the panel over a real Chromium window. Self-contained HTML, system fonts only, rendered with headless Chrome at device scale 2 and downscaled to 1600x1000.

artboards.title: Dark editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest hook and the most depth; the mock is the guest and the headline is the host. Trades realism for pull.

artboards.title: Paper editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Reads as print and is the only one that stands out in a dark gallery; feels less like a product shot and more like a poster.

artboards.title: Docked window
artboards.tradeoff: Reads as one Herdr window with the browser inside it, which is not what the mod does: herdr-browser opens Chromium in a window of its own. Kept as the record of that mistake.

artboards.title: Two windows
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the truth: the Chromium window herdr-browser opened, and Herdr with the panel docked next to it. Shipped as preview.png.
